description: This file defines RAII classes and helper functions for saving and restoring the state of C++ iostreams, specifically for use within the Abseil library's random internal components. It includes classes for saving ostream and istream flags, as well as helpers for handling 128-bit integers and floating-point parsing.

classes.name: null_state_saver
classes.description: A no-op RAII class that does nothing, used as a placeholder for stream state saving.

classes.name: ostream_state_saver
classes.description: A RAII class that saves and restores the state of an output stream (flags, fill, precision).

classes.name: istream_state_saver
classes.description: A RAII class that saves and restores the state of an input stream (flags).

methods.name: make_ostream_state_saver
methods.description: Factory function to create an ostream_state_saver with default or specified flags.

methods.name: make_istream_state_saver
methods.description: Factory function to create an istream_state_saver with default or specified flags.

methods.name: stream_precision_helper
methods.description: Template struct providing the required precision for streaming floating point types.

methods.name: stream_format_type
methods.description: Helper struct to convert certain types to streamable formats.

methods.name: stream_u128_helper
methods.description: Template struct specialized for handling absl::uint128 and __uint128_t types for streaming.

methods.name: read_floating_point
methods.description: Function to read floating point values from a stream, handling subnormal and underflow cases.
